component_sentence: The paper studies release-time governance for frozen scientific candidate universes under scarce one-sided verification, where unverified candidates are not negative labels and release, refusal, or route-to-audit are the scientific decisions.
lead_number: One primary headline, one T1 baseline frontier, and scoped boundary diagnostics are linked in the evidence hierarchy.
claim_boundary: problem-frame only; does not assert a new materials discovery result

component_sentence: CTC active verification is the strict anchor: a 0.5% top-score audit produced 20/20 nonempty safe CTC K=100 releases with zero observed false releases at alpha=0.10.
lead_number: 20/20 safe seeds; 2000 releases; 0 false releases; 200x budget ratio versus full random audit.
claim_boundary: completed simulated-audit strong positive for CTC only

component_sentence: The T1 empirical baseline frontier makes the materials contribution honest and comparable: raw prefixes, matched-size raw, thresholds, conformal, e-value, e-BH-style, PU, oracle, and PARC rows are shown together while only PARC carries the full release-certificate object.
lead_number: Empirical frontier includes 11 method families: Bao-style selective conformal adaptation, PARC, calibrated threshold, e-BH-style, fixed threshold, nnPU classifier release, oracle prefix, post-filter e-value, raw top-K, raw top-R, split conformal candidate threshold.
claim_boundary: target-object-aware baseline frontier; not equality of baseline guarantees

component_sentence: Materials is framed as a retrospective public-label release-policy frontier: ALIGNN K=300/500 shows fixed-budget utility and matched-volume diagnostics without claiming fixed-size ranking gain.
lead_number: ALIGNN K=300 raw top-K FTR 0.253; PARC FTR 0.087; raw top-R matched FTR 0.087; unstable follow-ups prevented 64.25. ALIGNN K=500 raw top-K FTR 0.327; PARC FTR 0.048; raw top-R matched FTR 0.048; unstable follow-ups prevented 158.30.
claim_boundary: retrospective public-label utility; raw top-R separates smaller queue effect

component_sentence: The materials validation boundary is part of the contribution: independent, external-source, and DFT-follow-up routes are kept out of positive evidence until their gates are completed.
lead_number: 5/5 materials independent/prospective validation routes are not positive evidence.
claim_boundary: do not claim independent or forward-looking materials validation success

component_sentence: Refusal is reported as an attributable governance decision: refusal rows are tied to evidence-mass or finite-resolution gates rather than treated as unexplained selector failures.
claim_boundary: refusal attribution diagnostic; not a new release-positive row

component_sentence: Human-audit rows are presented with interval uncertainty so zero observed false releases are not mistaken for universal zero risk.
lead_number: 2 audit interval rows with Clopper-Pearson, Wilson, and Jeffreys intervals.
claim_boundary: audited boundary support; external labels remain pending where not returned
